chunks.notes: This is the origin/awakening moment where a "blank" perceptual surface is broken by the first falling sound and subsequent tones, establishing the sound-built world before any conflict.
The chunk explicitly builds "invisible architecture," "arches of resonance, pillars of vibration, corridors" out of accumulating sound-layers, escalating in intricacy.

The final drop triggers the eyes opening and the sound-world's architecture collapsing back into silence as the POV slides from dream-ear to waking body and alarm, with the fading world explicitly framed as a fleeting memory.
